title: Pseudo-Label-Triggered Retraining from Forecast Errors for Online Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.39789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world time series forecasting systems operate under non-stationary data streams, where forecasting performance may degrade over time. Although retraining can recover the performance, it incurs non-trivial computational and operational costs. Under limited deployment resources, the key challenge is therefore not only how to retrain but also when to retrain. While existing retraining policies often rely on indirect indicators such as drift alarms or model staleness, we instead use realized forecast errors as direct deployment feedback. In this paper, we propose PILOT (Pseudo-label-Informed Learned Online Trigger), an online retraining framework that learns when to retrain from forecast-error dynamics. Since ground-truth retraining labels are unavailable, PILOT constructs a pseudo-label from future increases in forecast error and trains a lightweight scorer to predict it from observed error states. translated_title: 基于预测误差触发伪标签重训练的在线时间序列预测方法
translated_abstract: 真实世界的时间序列预测系统运行在非平稳数据流环境中，预测性能可能随时间推移而下降。虽然重训练可以恢复性能，但会带来不小的计算和运营成本。在部署资源有限的情况下，关键挑战因此不仅在于如何重训练，还在于何时重训练。现有的重训练策略通常依赖于漂移警报或模型过时程度等间接指标，而我们则使用实际发生的预测误差作为直接的部署反馈。在本文中，我们提出了PILOT（伪标签信息学习的在线触发器），这是一个从预测误差动态中学习何时重训练的在线重训练框架。由于真实的重训练标签不可用，PILOT从未来预测误差的增加中构建伪标签，并训练一个轻量级评分器根据观测到的误差状态来预测该伪标签。在部署时，PILOT仅使用……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出PILOT框架，利用预测误差构建伪标签并训练轻量级评分器，从误差动态中学习时间序列预测模型“何时重训练”，从而在有限部署资源下有效维持预测性能。
en_tdlr: PILOT is an online retraining framework that learns when to retrain time series forecasting models by constructing pseudo-labels from future forecast-error increases and training a lightweight scorer, enabling efficient retraining decisions under limited deployment resources.
